start: A member whose phone is set up and joined to a branded gym; the app is closed

steps.action: Open the app from its icon
user_sees: The splash, then the Workout tab first
The gym's colours and its small mark under the title
must_not: A flash of the default look before the gym's look
The tabs drawn over an empty database

user_sees: Exactly 3 tabs: 'Workout', 'Gym', 'Profile'
must_not: A 'Progress' or 'Coach' tab
Tabs in another order

user_sees: Each tab's page
must_not: The back button leaving the app from a non-first tab instead of going to Workout

start: A fresh install, never set up; the member taps the gym's invite link

user_sees: The welcome flow instead of the app
must_not: The Workout tab before setup
The link lost

user_sees: The 'Join <gym>' screen opens by itself
must_not: The join screen opening twice
No join screen at all

steps.action: Close the app half-way through the welcome flow, open it and finish
user_sees: The 'Join <gym>' screen still opens after setup
must_not: The kept link forgotten

start: A fresh install; the member scans the gym's check-in poster with the phone camera

steps.action: Open the poster link, finish the welcome flow
user_sees: 'Check in at <gym>' opens after setup
must_not: A check-in made before the member saw the screen

start: A newer phone version exists, and the watch app is older than the phone's

user_sees: Pop-up 'Update MettleUp'
The slim orange update line above the Workout tab
Later, 'Your watch app has an update'
must_not: Both pop-ups on top of each other
A pop-up that comes back on every tab change after it was closed

start: The phone's storage is full or the database upgrade fails on start

user_sees: The start-up error screen with a plain title and body
Buttons 'Try again' and 'Save my data file'
'Details' with what was recorded
must_not: The app drawn over a half-upgraded database
A blank white screen

user_sees: 'Preparing your file…', then the save
'Keep this file somewhere safe. If you need help, send it to your gym, who can pass it to MettleUp to open.'
must_not: The data file missing workouts

steps.action: Free some space and tap 'Try again'
user_sees: The app starts and opens on the Workout tab
must_not: Workouts lost after the retry

start: A set-up phone in no gym, in the default look

user_sees: The gym's opening, then every screen in the gym's colours
must_not: One screen left in the old colours

steps.action: The owner changes the gym's colours; the member comes back to the app an hour later with no workout open
user_sees: The new look shown under the gym's logo
must_not: The look changing in the middle of an open workout

user_sees: The default MettleUp look again on every screen
must_not: The old gym's colours or logo left on a screen or a widget

start: A member in no gym and with no MettleUp account

steps.action: Open the app and use it
user_sees: The app works fully offline
must_not: Any network call to the gym server while no gym is linked
Workouts copied to the cloud without an account
